inbox.title: Approval inbox (Director 00)
inbox.readonly: read-only: no PIN set on the laptop
inbox.escalated: High risk: type the confirmation phrase to finish.

alerts.title: Phone alerts
alerts.lead: A notification on this phone when Director 00 has something waiting for your approval, or when Phoenix restarts or loses a service. Alerts are encrypted end to end.
alerts.unsupported: Open OMEGA from the installed app over HTTPS to turn alerts on. On iPhone this needs iOS 16.4 or later and OMEGA added to the home screen.
alerts.blockedHelp: Notifications are blocked for OMEGA. Allow them in the phone's settings for this site, then come back.
alerts.onMsg: Alerts are on. A test notification is on its way.
alerts.offMsg: Alerts are off on this phone.

market.title: Markets & anomalies
market.none: No anomalies yet. They appear here the moment the relay pushes one.
market.chartError: Market data is unreachable right now.

sweeper.title: Profit Sweeper
sweeper.lead: How much gain your rules would set aside into a reserve. It only proposes: approving records the plan, and you make any sale yourself on your exchange.
sweeper.noPositions: No positions yet. Copy services/sweeper/positions.example.json to services/director00/data/positions.json on the laptop and fill in your holdings. It stays on the laptop.
sweeper.sent: Sent. The plan is waiting in your approval inbox.
sweeper.safety: OMEGA never trades or moves money; it has no exchange keys.

research.title: Research
research.hint: Ask the Brain anything. Six agents plan, research, design, critique and synthesize an answer.
research.placeholder: e.g. How would a Hormuz slowdown move Brent and gold this week?
research.error: The Brain is not reachable. Start the stack with docker compose up -d.

causal.title: Causal graph
causal.subtitle: Butterfly Engine: why did it happen?
causal.error: The Butterfly Engine could not run (services/causal/.venv).
causal.empty: No trace yet. Pick an anomaly and press Trace causes.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.subtitle: Monte Carlo over the causes, after a Bayesian update on the evidence
scenarios.legend: Bar length = probability; brighter = more confident; range = 10th to 90th percentile of the move.

director.title: Ask Director 00
director.lead: Runs on this laptop, no Docker needed. "Why" questions answer at once with the Butterfly Engine; anything that would change memory or send something waits in your approval inbox.
director.placeholder: Why did oil move near Hormuz? · remember: …
director.waiting: This became a proposal and is waiting for your approval.

earth.title: Earth
earth.noAlerts: Quiet. Fast-path alerts stream in here.
earth.subtitle: Live 3D globe: aircraft, ships, public webcams and day/night, from open data.

empty.cams: No public webcams in this view yet.
empty.flights: No aircraft in this view. Zoom into a region.
empty.ships: No ships in this view yet.
empty.events: No geolocated events in the last hour yet.

earth.keyHint: Add the free key in web/.env.local, then restart the app.

gl.title: 3D view paused
gl.body: The browser could not start WebGL2 (the graphics card was busy or reset). Reload to try again; closing other heavy tabs helps.

firms.missing: NASA FIRMS fire pixels: key not configured. Add NASA_FIRMS_KEY to web/.env.local.
firms.error: NASA FIRMS is unreachable or the key was refused; other hazards still update.

send.title: Send to Director 00
send.lead: A note, task, link or file from your phone. It waits in the approval inbox until you approve it; nothing runs on its own.
send.attach: Attach a photo, PDF, Word, Excel or PowerPoint file
send.sent: Sent. Waiting for your approval as
send.offline: The laptop can't be reached. Check you're on the same Wi-Fi.
send.safety: Files are checked by their contents and stored only; they are never opened or run.

atlas.title: Awesome atlas
atlas.lead: {total} curated awesome-lists of open-source tools and resources, searchable offline.
atlas.empty: No list matches. Try a broader word.
atlas.credit: From sindresorhus/awesome (CC0). Lists link to GitHub; nothing is installed from here.
atlas.open: Find tools in the Awesome atlas

network.title: Nervous system
network.lead: Every part of OMEGA as one network: {nodes} parts, {edges} connections.
network.status: Now: {up} healthy, {down} down, {key} waiting for a key.
network.pick: Click any node to see what it does and what it connects to.

library.title: Library
library.lead: Everything you sent from the phone. Word, Excel and PowerPoint open right here; photos live in Immich.
library.needPin: Enter your PIN to open the library.
library.empty: Nothing yet. Files you send from the phone appear here.
library.pick: Pick a file to preview it.
library.truncated: Showing the first 200 rows and 30 columns.
library.noPreview: No preview for this type. It's stored safely in the inbox folder on the laptop.
library.noPhotos: Immich is running but has no photos yet. Photos you send from the phone will land here.

not-configured.title: Photos are waiting for Docker
not-configured.body: Immich needs Docker. Once Docker runs: docker compose --profile photos up -d, create an API key in Immich, and add IMMICH_API_KEY to web/.env.local. Photos you send from then on are stored here too.

offline.title: Immich isn't answering
offline.body: It is configured but not running. Start it with: docker compose --profile photos up -d

misconfigured.title: Immich address is not allowed
misconfigured.body: IMMICH_URL must point at this laptop (127.0.0.1) so the API key never leaves it.

error.title: Immich returned an error
error.body: Check that the API key in web/.env.local is still valid.

review.title: Review
review.lead: The judgement calls OMEGA runs on. Approve each one when it looks right; if it changes later, it shows as changed until you look again.
review.needPin: Enter your PIN to open the review.

sources.title: News source trust
sources.lead: How much the Truth Layer trusts each kind of outlet before other sources confirm a story. A story needs 0.7 or more to show as verified.

butterfly.title: Butterfly Engine assumptions
butterfly.lead: Starting numbers for the cause-and-effect scenarios. They are judgement, not fitted from data, so every probability depends on them.

keys.root_prior: Chance any one root cause is active

restic.title: Backup password
restic.lead: Backups are encrypted with RESTIC_PASSWORD from giant-core/.env on the laptop. Without it they can't be restored. Save it in a password manager, then confirm here.

sweeper.title: Profit Sweeper rules
sweeper.lead: When a position is up at least the threshold, this share of the gain is proposed for the reserve, if the amount is worth a transaction. You can edit them here; each edit needs your approval again.

keys.min_gain_pct: Sweep when gain is at least
keys.sweep_share: Share of the gain to set aside

sweeper.afterSave: After saving, approve the new version below.

keys.title: Data keys
keys.lead: Free keys that switch on extra live data. Put them in web/.env.local on the laptop, then tap the button: they load without a restart and each one is tested.
keys.where: Keys stay on the laptop. This screen never shows their values.

command.title: Command Center
command.lead: Everything at a glance. Tell Director 00 what you need from one place.

vault.title: Keys Vault
vault.lead: Paste your keys here. The laptop stores them encrypted and tests them.

status.ok: Connected to the laptop · link valid
status.expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.
status.missing: No vault link is open on the laptop.
status.offline: Can't reach the laptop. Are you on the home Wi-Fi?

vault.noClipboard: The browser didn't allow pasting. Long-press the field and paste instead.
vault.wipe: This page clears itself in {s} s.
vault.safety: The link works once, for 10 minutes. Keys are encrypted on the laptop, never logged, and cleared from this page as soon as you tap save.
